name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.mem_descendR
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν))
  (rls : List.{0} (List.{0} ν)) (y z : ν),
  Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.descendR N U rls y) z →
    Or (Eq.{1} z y) (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (List.flatten.{0} rls) z)

source.code:
theorem mem_descendR (U : List (ν × ν)) : ∀ (rls : List (List ν)) (y z : ν),
    z ∈ N.descendR U rls y → z = y ∨ z ∈ rls.flatten
  | [], y, z, h => by simp [descendR] at h; exact Or.inl h
  | L :: rest, y, z, h => by
      simp only [descendR, List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with rfl | h
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · cases hf : L.find? (fun x => decide (N.ResL U x y)) with
        | none => rw [hf] at h; simp at h
        | some x =>
            rw [hf] at h
            rcases mem_descendR U rest x z h with rfl | h'
            · exact Or.inr (by simp [List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf])
            · exact Or.inr (by simp [h'])
